:::{#exm-generated-sigma-algebra}
#### The $\sigma$-algebra generated by the even rolls

For the die rolls $D = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
let $\mathscr{C} = \set{\set{2, 4, 6}}$.
Every $\sigma$-algebra on $D$ that contains $\set{2, 4, 6}$
must also contain $D$, the complement $\set{1, 3, 5}$, and $\emptyset$
(@def-sigma-algebra and @thm-sigma-algebra-closure).
The collection $\set{\emptyset, \set{2, 4, 6}, \set{1, 3, 5}, D}$
is already a $\sigma$-algebra (@exm-sigma-algebra),
so it is $\sigma(\mathscr{C})$.

:::
